title: Plots in Villianur | Land for Sale & Property Guide
description: Looking for an affordable plot in Villianur? What drives prices, which approvals to confirm, and how we verify layouts before you pay anything.
lead: Villianur sits west of the town centre, toward Villupuram. It is where buyers look when budgets are tighter and they still want to be close to Pondicherry.
wa: Hi, I am interested in plots in Villianur

guide.label: Tell us what you need in Villianur

paras: It is a commuter belt with a mix of older village streets and newer layouts. Prices are generally easier than in the centre of town, which brings first-time buyers and small investors.
New layouts appear quickly here, and quality varies a lot between them.

Buyers comparing it with the Tindivanam highway belt

paras: Do not judge a layout by its brochure. Confirm the approval number and who issued it, that the roads shown are really laid and the width matches the plan, and that drainage and water are actually provided.

Check the parent documents back through the previous owners, the encumbrance certificate and the patta. Then walk the plot with the layout plan and check boundary marking. We do this before showing you anything.
If you would rather buy a plot from a layout we have developed ourselves, see [our layouts](/our-projects) and ask what is open now.

items.q: Are plots in Villianur cheaper than in town?
items.a: Generally yes, which is why many first-time buyers look here. Price still depends on the road, the approval status and how close the plot is to a main road, so compare each plot on its own.

items.q: How do I know a layout is approved?
items.a: Ask for the approval number and the issuing authority, then check that the layout on the ground matches the approved plan. We verify this for every property we show.

items.q: Can you arrange a site visit?
items.a: Yes. We arrange visits with pickup from Pondicherry town and show only plots whose documents we have already checked.
